description: Golden retrieval traces over the checked-in rag_corpus DOCS using the offline deterministic (hashing) embedder. Each case pins a query to the document that must be retrieved FIRST and to the evidence terms the retrieved chunk itself must contain, so a chunker/cosine/threshold/metadata regression fails on evidence quality, not just a recall floor. decoy_keys name the corpus documents most likely to be confused with the target (they must never outrank it).
